# Judgment-Proof Status [2026]: What It Means When Creditors
> Last updated: 2026-09-25

> Judgment-proof status (also spelled judgement-proof) means a creditor with a court judgment cannot collect because all your income and assets are protected't collect because you have no non-exempt income or assets. Free 2026 guide.

## About
judgmentproof.org is part of the Open Bankruptcy Project (openbankruptcyproject.org), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit building free, open-source tools for bankruptcy court transparency.
